0022600042.text: The LA Clippers (2-8, 0-5 on the road, 13th in the West) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (8-3, 5-0 at home, 6th in the West) in the Clippers' 11th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. The Thunder are missing Ajay Mitchell (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and the Clippers trail the season series 0-1 after a 108-101 loss in Oklahoma City on October 25, following an 0-3 sweep by the Thunder in 2025-26.
